from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class JudgmentDocument(BaseModel):
    """Represents one judgment document from the collection with its relevant classification details."""
    title: str = Field(description="The title or identifier of the judgment document (e.g., 判决文书 1, 行政再审审查裁定书)")
    cause_of_action: str | None = Field(description="The specific legal cause of action (案由) stated in the document")
    case_type: str | None = Field(description="The general legal nature of the case, e.g., 'Civil' (民事) or 'Administrative' (行政)")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[JudgmentDocument]
